# Problem-framing canvas

Copy into a dated shared record and complete collaboratively before finalising the ML task.

- **Record date / status:**

| Prompt | Group response |
| --- | --- |
| Stakeholder or real-world context | |
| Decision the stakeholder needs to make | |
| Primary lens | |
| Secondary lens and how it strengthens the primary lens | |
| Problem statement | |
| Exact ML/data-mining task | |
| Unit of analysis (what one row represents) | |
| Target and its interpretation | |
| Intended output and decision use | |
| Study area and domain of use | |
| Candidate data sources | |
| Why this is a suitable, manageable ML problem | |
| Success criteria | |
| Feasibility evidence and scope constraints | |
| Ethical, privacy, and data-use considerations | |
| Approval status and evidence | |
| Assumptions and unresolved questions | |

Link approval and feasibility evidence when present. A proposed stakeholder or benefit is not a confirmed engagement. Use the primary lens to justify the task; the optional secondary lens must strengthen it.
